name: InterContinental ANA Beppu Resort & Spa
positioning: ANA InterContinental Beppu Resort & Spa: a hot spring resort in the foothills above Beppu, in the Kannawa area, with an open-air onsen bath, a heated infinity pool and views over Beppu Bay and the mountains
best_for: Travelers who want an onsen stay with views of Beppu Bay
Guests wanting a room or suite that may include a private onsen

facts.text: The hotel is in the Kannawa area of Beppu.
The onsen uses the waters of Myoban, one of Beppu's renowned hot spring areas, celebrated for their skin-beautifying qualities.
The spa experience at HARNN Heritage Spa is inspired by the nature and culture of Beppu and Oita.
Spa treatments include body scrubs, body wraps, facials and foot reflexology.
Rooms have calming Japanese-inspired design with modern amenities.
Guests are welcomed with a glass of original blend TWG tea.
The Panorama Suite may include a balcony, a private onsen and Beppu Bay views.
The One Bedroom Suite may include an outdoor hot tub.
The restaurants, bars and lounges are inspired by Japan's five elements of earth, water, fire, wind and void.
Sushi Musui serves seasonal seafood sourced from the coastline of Bungo Oita.
Beppu offers thermal pools, sand baths and hell-steamed seafood among its hot spring sights and experiences.

highlights.text: The Myoban Onsen Retreat is a rustic open-air bath crafted from Beppu stone, with panoramic views of Beppu Bay and the city below.
The resort is perched in the foothills overlooking Beppu, with views of lush mountains, Beppu Bay and natural hot springs.
HARNN Heritage Spa was created by HARNN, a luxury brand from Thailand, and draws on Eastern traditions and natural healing practices.
The heated outdoor infinity pool has an open-air view of Beppu, a patio with sunloungers and a jacuzzi.
Classic Rooms may include a balcony and a private onsen.

considerations.text: Oita Airport is about 40.6 kilometers from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the resort is located away from Beppu city center.
